name: GodStra (genetic 'DNA' rule generator over many indicators)
author: @Mablue (Masoud Azizi)
indicators: huge indicator set (TA lib); rules gene-encoded: operator (>,<,=,CA,CB,>I,<I,>R,<R) between indicator/cross-indicator/int/real
entry_long: AND of gene rules defined in buy_params (each: indicator OPR cross-indicator or constant)
implementation_notes: A search framework, not one strategy; the found gene set is overfit. Archive as method only (P3). The sibling GodStraNew lives under lookahead_bias/ folder, i.e. known lookahead. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
